annotations.text:
Spec 037 FR-015 mock — the header stack (CustomerBar + OrderHeaderPanel), for review before implementing FR-016/FR-016a.
Every field but Comment uses one shared shape: a small caption over a dense value/control, exactly like the payment-terms control already does today.
Desktop artboards are 1440 wide — a genuine 'large' tier, where the shared form grid caps at 1200px.

Due date, promise date and salesperson now sit on the first row beside Fecha.
One caption rule and one value rule for every field on the screen — no uppercase, no per-field sizes. Dropdowns carry a down arrow, pickers a right chevron; the date fields carry neither, since the chevron pushed their datetime value into an ellipsis. The one value variation left is monospace for the order reference.
Compact tier at a real 390px phone width. The header is two columns: Referencia / Estado, then Fecha / Vendedor, then the two fulfilment dates side by side.
